configuration.analysis: holding MFE and post-stop recovery, descriptive follow-up v1
configuration.owner_request: 统计过最大打到的 R 吗，还有止损后立马又回来的这种呢
configuration.risk: Original entry minus original stop, signed by side; frozen after exit.
configuration.clock: Start at the stop-hit 5m bar close; observe only subsequent complete 5m bars. Exclude the ambiguous remainder of the stop-hit bar. Timing is bar resolution, not exact execution time.
configuration.boundary: Do not cross original segment right edge. A horizon contributes only when fully observed; report censored counts.
configuration.holding_mfe: Keep conservative existing peak_r and independently reconstruct it. Stop-hit bar favorable wick excluded; its possible contribution recorded separately as an upper bound.
configuration.recovery: Touch and 5m close reclamation of entry are separate. Post-exit R is a hypothetical price displacement, not a realized trade return.
configuration.adverse_excursion: For entry recovery, include stop-hit bar and recovery-hit bar full adverse extremes as a conservative adverse bound; intrabar order unknown.
configuration.control: Reuse frozen same-side/week/causal-volatility matched random entries; show stopped-population rates and jointly eligible pairs where both stopped, explicitly conditional.
configuration.scope: No new strategy or parameter selection. No Pine changes, reentry performance claims, or live actions.

interpretation: Descriptive excursions; future recovery is not a realizable strategy payoff. No strategy, cost, or sizing changes.
